description.text:
The deck that won the Junior Division of the 2024 World Championships, one few opponents expected. Nearly half of it is Ancient cards, which discard the opponent's cards, recycle Energy and give extra HP; once in the discard pile they power up Roaring Moon's Vengeance Fletching, and its focus on single-Prize Pokémon gives the opponent an uphill battle. The 2024 World Championships were held at the Hawai'i Convention Center in Honolulu from 16 to 18 August 2024, back in Hawaii for the first time since 2012.

Pokémon sold it as one of four 2024 World Championships decks: a 60-card copy of the deck with a booklet, a pin, a coin, a deck box, a playmat, a poster and a code card for Pokémon Trading Card Game Live. Its cards have a limited-edition back, a silver border and the player's signature on the picture, and are not legal in tournaments.
